run.note: Counts, operation names and error codes only; no resource content and no error messages (they can name resources). The 213 entries that were not ok, empty or not-exercised on the first pass were re-run with the collector's own outcome classifier (error_outcomes.json) and the service-style refusal codes, and a further 21 were re-run after the second change; each re-run replaces the first result. Account identifiers are removed. Compared with wave0-2026-11-01.json the ok, empty and denied sets are the same; only the labels of non-ok entries changed.
